description: Bounded retransmission protocol (de-probabilised, game cast on an MDP). Each chunk may be retransmitted at most MAX times; if it is still lost afterwards the transfer ABORTS. Can the sender (coalition) SURELY deliver the whole file of N chunks against a worst-case channel? Expected UNKNOWN -- a soundness witness (the quantitative original has P[abort] > 0): a channel that drops one chunk MAX+1 times forces an abort. Both N (chunks) and the per-chunk bound (max) are adversary-chosen and NOT fixed in advance.
